foundation.description: Zero se start karein. Seekhein ki Python data, decisions, aur flow ke baare mein kaise sochta hai — step by step, har concept animated.

beginner.description: Real programming habits banayein. Loops, functions, aur lists ko ek ek step mein chalte dekhkar master karein.

intermediate.audience: Scripts aur apps ship karne waale builders
intermediate.description: Apni toolkit upgrade karein. Visual state tracking ke saath dictionaries, stacks, queues aur pehle search algorithms explore karein.

advanced.audience: Problem solving refine karne waale engineers
advanced.description: Algorithmically sochein. Sorting aur tree algorithms ko real time mein animate hote dekhein, observation se Big O samjhein.

mastery.description: Frontier tak pahunchein. Graph search, dynamic programming, aur interview-level algorithms — sab live visualized.

algorithms.hello-world: Aapka pehla Python output. Dekhein ki print() console par data kaise bhejta hai aur yeh sabhi debugging ki neenv kyun hai.
algorithms.variables-types: Ek variable ko memory mein jeevant hote dekhein. int, float, str, aur bool ko living boxes ke roop mein dekhein jo values hold karte hain.
algorithms.string-operations: Strings sequences hain. Slicing, concatenation aur methods ko character arrays par animate hote dekhein.
algorithms.arithmetic: Numbers, operators aur integer division. Dekhein ki Python step by step expressions evaluate kaise karta hai.
algorithms.if-else: Decisions lene wala code. Truthiness ke basis par execution ko branches ke beech jump karte dekhein.
algorithms.while-loop: Condition se driven repetition. Dekhein ki loop guard har iteration se pehle check karta hai aur infinite loops kyun hote hain.
algorithms.for-loop: Sequences par iterate karein. Dekhein ki Python ka for loop asli mein andar se ek iterator kaise hai.
algorithms.lists-basics: Python ka sabse useful container. Append, pop aur index ko animated memory block par operations ke roop mein dekhein.
algorithms.functions-intro: Logic ke reusable blocks. Ek function call ko stack frame push karte aur return value ko caller tak flow hote dekhein.
algorithms.input-output: Users se baat karne waale programs. Dekhein ki input() execution kaise pause karta hai aur ek string value return karta hai.
algorithms.linear-search: Har element ko tab tak check karein jab tak target na mil jaaye. O(n) — sabse simple search algorithm.
algorithms.count-occurrences: Count karein ki koi value kitni baar dikhti hai. Hash map ko har pass ke saath counts accumulate karte dekhein.
algorithms.find-min-max: Ek hi pass mein running minimum aur maximum track karein. Dekhein ki ek loop kyun kaafi hai.
algorithms.sum-average: Values accumulate karein aur mean compute karein. Woh accumulator pattern dekhein jo kai algorithms ko power deta hai.
algorithms.loop-explorer: Dekhein ki loop iterations shared state kaise update karte hain. Score ko har pass ke saath accumulate hote dekhein.
algorithms.reverse-list: Dono sides se two-pointer swap. Pointers ko beech mein milne tak andar move karte dekhein.
algorithms.palindrome: Dono sides se characters compare karein. Dekhein ki two-pointer technique symmetry confirm kaise karti hai.
algorithms.fizzbuzz: Classic divisibility check. 100 iterations mein modulo ko conditional output drive karte dekhein.
algorithms.factorial: 1 se n tak multiply karein. Product ko step by step badhte dekhein aur samjhein ki 0! = 1 kyun hai.
algorithms.fibonacci-iterative: Do rolling variables ke saath sequence generate karein. Dekhein ki yeh space mein recursive version ko kyun beat karta hai.
algorithms.binary-search: Har step par search space ko aadha karein. Sorted input zaroori. O(log n) ko live hote dekhein.
algorithms.selection-sort: Har pass mein minimum dhundhein aur front mein move karein. n passes ko sorted array produce karte dekhein.
algorithms.insertion-sort: Har element ko already-sorted prefix mein sahi position par insert karein. Nearly sorted data ke liye efficient.
algorithms.two-pointers: O(n²) ki jagah O(n) mein array problems solve karne ke liye ek dusre ki taraf move karte do indices use karein.
algorithms.hash-map-counting: O(1) per lookup mein count karne ke liye dictionary use karein. Kai frequency problems ki foundation.
algorithms.stack-ops: LIFO action mein. List par stack ke roop mein push, pop, aur peek animate hote dekhein.
algorithms.queue-ops: FIFO action mein. Enqueue aur dequeue animate hote dekhein aur samjhein ki deque list se better kyun hai.
algorithms.anagram-check: Kya do strings ek dusre ki rearrangements hain? O(n) mein character counting se solve karte dekhein.
algorithms.sliding-window: Size k ki har window mein maximum sum dhundhein. Window ko array par slide karte dekhein.
algorithms.merge-sorted: Do sorted arrays ko ek mein combine karein. Merge sort ke peeche ka core operation.
algorithms.bubble-sort: Adjacent pairs compare karein. Bade elements har pass mein upar bubble karte hain.
algorithms.merge-sort: Divide karein, halves sort karein, merge karein. Recursion tree ko split aur recombine hote dekhein.
algorithms.quick-sort: Ek pivot choose karein, uske around partition karein, recurse karein. Average O(n log n) great cache performance ke saath.
algorithms.heap-sort: Max-heap banayein, elements ko order mein extract karein. Quicksort ke unlike guaranteed O(n log n).
algorithms.bfs: Queue use karke graph ko level by level explore karein. Unweighted graphs mein shortest paths dhundhein.
algorithms.dfs: Backtracking se pehle jitna deep ho sake explore karein. Har recursive step ke saath call stack badhte dekhein.
algorithms.binary-tree-traversal: In-order, pre-order, post-order. Ek hi tree par nodes ko different sequences mein visit hote dekhein.
algorithms.two-sum: Do numbers dhundhein jo target mein add hote hain. Dekhein ki hash map O(n²) ko O(n) mein kaise badalta hai.
algorithms.valid-parentheses: Open aur close brackets match karne ke liye stack use karein. Classic stack application interview question.
algorithms.fibonacci-recursive: Call tree ko exponentially fan out hote dekhein. Samjhein ki memoization kyun zaroori hai.
algorithms.dijkstra: Priority queue use karke source se sabhi nodes tak shortest paths dhundhein. GPS navigation ki backbone.
algorithms.knapsack: Weight limit ke andar value maximize karein. DP table ko row by row bharte dekhein.
algorithms.lcs: Do strings mein shared sabse lamba subsequence dhundhein. Diff tools aur DNA alignment ka core.
algorithms.topological-sort: Dependencies respect karte hue tasks ko order karein. Kahn's algorithm ko zero in-degree nodes hataate dekhein.
algorithms.kruskals: Cycles banaye bina lowest-weight edges ko greedily add karke minimum spanning tree banayein.
algorithms.trie: Letter by letter strings insert aur search karein. Dekhein ki autocomplete under the hood kaise kaam karta hai.
algorithms.floyd-warshall: 3-loop DP ke saath all-pairs shortest paths. O(V³) mein distance matrix update hote dekhein.
algorithms.segment-tree: O(log n) mein range queries aur point updates. Tree build aur sums upar propagate hote dekhein.
algorithms.coin-change: Ek amount banane ke liye minimum coins. DP array ko 0 se target tak bharte dekhein.
algorithms.bit-manipulation: AND, OR, XOR, shifts — cryptography, graphics, aur competitive programming ke peeche ke operations.
